author: Rev Fab fire
dailyPrayer: Heavenly Father, we come before You today with grateful hearts, acknowledging the gentle and transformative work of Your Holy Spirit within us. Thank You for the Ruach ha-Qodesh, who comforts, guides, and empowers us to walk in Your truth and love. As we navigate the challenges of this day, may Your Spirit fill us with a deep and abiding peace, reminding us that we are never alone. Help us to listen to His still, small voice, leading us in paths of righteousness and grace. Lord, renew our hearts and minds, so we may be a reflection of Your love to all we encounter. In Jesus' name, we pray, Amen.

wordOfTheDay.meaning: This word is often translated as 'Advocate,' 'Comforter,' or 'Helper,' referring to the Holy Spirit as one who supports, guides, and intercedes for believers.
wordOfTheDay.verse: John 14:16-17: 'And I will ask the Father, and he will give you another Helper, to be with you forever, even the Spirit of truth, whom the world cannot receive, because it neither sees him nor knows him. You know him, for he dwells with you and will be in you.'
wordOfTheDay.reflection: The Holy Spirit as παράκλητος offers believers a profound sense of comfort and guidance. In times of uncertainty, we can lean on God’s Spirit, who walks alongside us, offering wisdom, solace, and the assurance of His eternal presence.
